# Fishgoo Spreadsheet

> Buyer-focused landing page for Fishgoo users sourcing finds from Taobao, Weidian and 1688. Covers link verification, QC photo decisions, sizing risk, shipping cost, agent comparisons and refund safety.

## Editorial Principle

Do not build pages as keyword lists. Start every page from a real buyer pain point, then include search language naturally inside useful answers.

## Primary URLs

- [Home](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/): main landing page covering buyer pain points, category guides and FAQ.
- [Official Fishgoo](https://w2clinks.com/spreadsheet/fishgoo/?page=1&sort=newest&typeid=7&category=SNEAKERS&utm_source=fishgoospreadsheet&utm_medium=aggregator&utm_campaign=fishgoo&utm_content=cat-shoes381): the live Fishgoo agent app.

## On-page Sections

- [Home hero](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#home): main landing hero.
- [Finds](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#finds): twelve product-category guide cards.
- [Beginner Guide](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#beginner-guide): step-by-step buying workflow.
- [Fishgoo Spreadsheet hub](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#spreadsheet): article hub for spreadsheet trust, dead links and marketplace choice.
- [Shipping Guide](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#shipping-guide): QC, parcel cost and safety guidance.
- [Coupons](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#coupons): first-order, shipping and seasonal deal guidance.
- [Comparisons](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#comparisons): agent and spreadsheet tool comparisons.
- [Blog](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#blog): article-style internal links for beginner, link audit, QC and shipping topics.
- [FAQ](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#faq): answers written from real buying friction.
- [Contact](https://fishgoospreadsheet.net/#contact): final call-to-action and official Fishgoo links.

## Buyer Pain Points to Cover

1. Spreadsheet links can be dead, duplicated, outdated or missing seller context.
2. New buyers are confused by the difference between Taobao, Weidian and 1688.
3. QC photos decide whether users approve, exchange or return an item.
4. Shipping cost often surprises buyers after items arrive at the warehouse.
5. Sizing, batches, fabric and measurements vary by category and seller.
6. Buyers need balanced safety checks for agents, sellers, refunds and shipping lines.

## Recommended Article Plan

1. Beginner walkthrough: how to use Fishgoo from link discovery to parcel submission.
2. Spreadsheet link audit: freshness, seller context, duplicates and missing details.
3. Marketplace comparison: when to use Taobao, Weidian or 1688.
4. Category buying guides: what goes wrong per category and what to check.
5. QC photo decision guide: measurements, alignment, stitching, defects, extra photos, return decisions.
6. Shipping cost guide: actual weight, volume weight, line choice, insurance, sensitive items, customs risk.
7. Safety and refund guide: payment, seller reliability, support evidence, realistic buyer protection.
8. Agent comparison pages: compare tradeoffs without hype.

## FAQ Direction

- *What is a Fishgoo spreadsheet?* Explain it as a curated discovery and buying-support page, not a raw list of products.
- *How do I use Fishgoo Spreadsheet?* Explain search, link checking, warehouse QC, shipping choice and parcel submission.
- *Is Fishgoo safe and legit?* Provide a balanced checklist for seller signals, QC photos, support history, shipping route and local import rules.

## Update Frequency

Review content regularly — marketplace links, agent workflows, shipping lines and buyer questions change quickly.
